name: drift-tube-gas-flow
description: Closed form: L / (mu E + v_gas), with both declared. The same drift tube with the neutral gas streaming through it at 120 m/s. GAS-1 calls a bulk gas velocity easy to omit and hard to notice missing, and this is why: the drift is now 300 m/s rather than 180, so two thirds of the transport is the gas rather than the field, and a model that left it out would be describing a different instrument at the same pressure. Advection is not the gradient of anything, so it cannot enter as a potential - it adds to the drift directly, and the transit is L / (mu E + v_gas).
